cities.attr: Population: how many people live in the city proper (latest estimate).

mountains.attr: Elevation: the height of the summit above sea level, in metres.

rivers.attr: Length: the length of the river from source to mouth, in kilometres.

companies.attr: Revenue: the company's most recent annual revenue, in US dollars.

films.attr: Box office: the film's worldwide theatrical gross, in US dollars.

elements.attr: Atomic number: the number of protons in the nucleus.
